summary: Lincoln County lookout near Waldport: crow's nest in 1924, a tower by 1931-32, listed abandoned in 1959; a second register site is nearby.

notes_for_editor: Record fit is uncertain. Only firelookout.com's entry (1924 crow's nest, 1926 cabin, 1932 50-ft pole tower, abandoned 1959) is clearly tied to #1. The Lincoln FPA reports, the 1931 Siuslaw Oar item, and the ORWW page name no site number. The register's #2 entry (US 742, OR 151) describes a 1959 tower moved from Little Hebo and removed in 1973, which the 1958 Lincoln FPA report also describes. By the index coordinates, #1 and #2 are under a kilometre apart (my calculation from the two points). A human should decide whether #1 is a separate structure or a duplicate of #2 before publishing. Disagreements left in the story: first lookout date (1915, 1917 or 1924); height (60 ft in 1931 vs 50 ft in 1932); 1959 abandonment vs 1960 cabin work; given names or nicknames of Kocher differ (Pat, H. L., Pap). Not found: what became of the 1931-32 tower when the 1958 tower arrived. No current source on access or condition, so access is not recorded. Register text says 102 ft; Lincoln FPA says 100 ft.
